name: Read Emails from Gmail
description: Search and read emails from Gmail with full content. Handles the two-step list+detail pattern: first lists message IDs matching a query, then fetches each message's full content with decoded headers and body.

query.description: Gmail search query (same syntax as Gmail search bar). Examples: 'from:alice', 'subject:invoice after:2024/01/01', 'is:unread label:INBOX'

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response to get the next page

steps.name: List message IDs matching the query
Check if any messages were found
Fetch full content for each message
